## Quarto

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
raw_set <- read_csv(
  "OECD_raw_set.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#change the label of country
country_lab <- c(
  AUS = "Australia", AUT = "Austria", BEL = "Belgium", BGR = "Bulgaria",
  CAN = "Canada", CHE = "Switzerland", CHL = "Chile", COL = "Colombia",
  CRI = "Costa Rica", CZE = "Czechia", DEU = "Germany", ESP = "Spain",
  EST = "Estonia", FRA = "France", GBR = "United Kingdom", GRC = "Greece",
  HUN = "Hungary", IRL = "Ireland", ISR = "Israel", ITA = "Italy",
  LTU = "Lithuania", LUX = "Luxembourg", LVA = "Latvia", MEX = "Mexico",
  NLD = "Netherlands", NOR = "Norway", NZL = "New Zealand", OECD = "OECD average",
  POL = "Poland", PRT = "Portugal", ROU = "Romania", SVK = "Slovak Republic",
  SVN = "Slovenia", SWE = "Sweden", USA = "United States"
)
```

```{r}
sex_lab <- c("F" = "Female", "M" = "Male", "_T" = "Total")

age_lab <- c(
  "Y25T34" = "25-34", "Y35T44" = "35-44", "Y45T54" = "45-54",
  "Y55T64" = "55-64", "Y25T64" = "25-64 (all)"
)

edu_lab <- c(
  "ISCED11A_0T2" = "Below upper secondary",
  "ISCED11A_3_4" = "Upper secondary / post-secondary non-tertiary",
  "ISCED11A_5T8" = "Tertiary",
  "_T"           = "All levels"
)

arrival_lab <- c(
  "Y_LT16" = "Arrived before age 16",
  "Y_GE16" = "Arrived at age 16 or older",
  "_T"     = "All arrival ages"
)

status_lab <- c("A" = "Normal value", "U" = "Low reliability", "O" = "Missing value")

```

```{r}
cleaned_data <- raw_set |>
  select(REF_AREA, TIME_PERIOD, SEX, AGE, ATTAINMENT_LEV,
         MIGRATION_AGE, OBS_VALUE, OBS_STATUS) |>
  mutate(
    country     = unname(country_lab[REF_AREA]),
    sex         = unname(sex_lab[SEX]),
    age         = unname(age_lab[AGE]),
    education   = unname(edu_lab[ATTAINMENT_LEV]),
    arrival_age = unname(arrival_lab[MIGRATION_AGE]),
    obs_status  = unname(status_lab[OBS_STATUS])
  ) |>
  rename(
    country_code = REF_AREA,
    year = TIME_PERIOD,
    unemployment_rate_pct = OBS_VALUE
  ) |>
  select(country_code, country, year, sex, age, education,
         arrival_age, unemployment_rate_pct, obs_status)

# 4. Check for unmatched codes (every value should be FALSE)
cleaned_data |>
  summarise(across(c(country, sex, age, education, arrival_age, obs_status),
                   ~ any(is.na(.x))))

```

```{r}
head(cleaned_data)
write_excel_csv(cleaned_data, "cleaned_data.csv")
```

```{r}
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data |>
  filter(sex != "Total",
         education != "All levels",
         arrival_age != "All arrival ages",
         age != "25-64 (all)",
         country != "OECD average")

# 檢查
cleaned_data |> count(sex)
cleaned_data |> count(age)
cleaned_data |> count(education)
cleaned_data |> count(arrival_age)
```

```{r}
#只用2023年的資料
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(unemployment_rate_pct))
```

```{r}
cleaned_data |>
  count(sex)
```

```{r}
#把國家按照不同區域排
data <- read_csv("cleaned_data.csv")
class(data)

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      country %in% c("Norway", "Sweden") ~ "Northern Europe",
      country %in% c("Austria", "Belgium", "Switzerland", "Germany", "France",
                     "United Kingdom", "Ireland", "Luxembourg", "Netherlands") ~ "Western Europe",
      country %in% c("Bulgaria", "Czechia", "Estonia", "Hungary", "Lithuania",
                     "Latvia", "Poland", "Romania", "Slovak Republic", "Slovenia") ~ "Eastern Europe",
      country %in% c("Spain", "Greece", "Italy", "Portugal") ~ "Southern Europe",
      country %in% c("Chile", "Colombia", "Costa Rica", "Mexico") ~ "Latin America",
      country %in% c("Canada", "United States") ~ "North America",
      country %in% c("Australia", "New Zealand") ~ "Oceania",
      country == "Israel" ~ "Middle East",
      country == "OECD average" ~ "OECD average",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#刪掉OECD average的國家
data <- data |>
  filter(country != "OECD")
```
